title: Kennings and Variation
subtitle: Bānhūs, hronrād — metaphor and repetition.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Old English poetry and prose.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Kenning: a compound metaphor (bānhūs = bone-house = body; hronrād = whale-road = sea; beadoleoma = battle-light = sword). Variation: restating the same idea in different words (se cyning, se hlāford, se beaggifa = the king, the lord, the ring-giver). Both are hallmarks of Old English poetic style.
